five_day_thesis: Spot has advanced $267.20 (+6.44%) over five sessions from $4,151.80 to $4,419.00 with only one down day, and ATM IV expanded alongside it from 21.36% to 22.60% (+1.24pp) — a rally the options market is paying up for rather than fading. Net window GEX has grown 5.6x from +79.11 to +443.55 while staying positive all five sessions, so dealers are progressively longer gamma and the regime is increasingly vol-dampening, not vol-amplifying. Both structural walls are unchanged to the tick across the window — put wall pinned at $3,500, call wall at $8,000 — so the entire advance happened inside a static OI frame, with fresh positioning instead stacking at $5,000 (+1,495 calls) and $4,800 (+699). Put builds were an order of magnitude smaller and clustered at $4,050 (+340) and $4,120 (+239), well below spot: downside hedging is thin and defensive, not aggressive. Reported max pain has been frozen at $6,500 every session because 68% of call OI sits at or above $5,000 — treat that print as a legacy-OI artifact, not a magnet.
